policies.text: Cross-border transit clearance is awarded to any bus operator holding an international transit operator licence.

Preferred logistics status is attained either through a customer satisfaction rating of 90 percent or higher alongside a vehicle fleet of at least 15 units, or by holding an active ISO 9001 quality certificate.
An air cargo warehouse earns rapid clearance status when its annual storage capacity exceeds 50,000 metric tons.
An enterprise achieves primary transit vendor recognition if it possesses preferred logistics status while maintaining corporate liability coverage of at least 5,000,000 USD.
An entity secures a regional transport contract when it has primary transit vendor recognition and maintains an average response time of 30 minutes or less.
An aviation operator attains approved flight partner status provided its operational safety rating is at least 90 points.
A maritime carrier receives deep-water docking rights if it maintains a fleet size of at least 10 vessels and possesses a harbor safety permit.
A hospitality venue receives premium shuttle service classification if it maintains a dedicated guest shuttle fleet of at least 5 vans.
